diagnosis: The endpoint relies on the reusable dependency get_project_by_id to fetch the project from the path parameter, and injects current_user separately. However, get_project_by_id only validates existence, and the route handler assumes the dependency handled authorization. Because neither verifies project.organization_id == current_user.organization_id, any authenticated user can view sensitive financial figures for projects belonging to rival organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /projects/512/financials HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
